messages.単体の敵に撃って火傷6と脆弱を残し、次のターンの味方の火力を底上げする、色欲斬撃: A starting Lust Slash E.G.O used on a single enemy to leave 6 Burn and Fragile behind, raising allies' damage on the next turn.
messages.脆弱の付与: 次のターンに脆弱1を付与する。解析Ⅲでは表面的中時のみ、解析Ⅳでは: **Inflicting Fragile**: Inflicts 1 Fragile next turn. At Threadspin Ⅲ it applies only on Heads Hit, and at Threadspin Ⅳ it also applies on hit, totaling 2 on Heads Hit. Higher SP makes Heads more likely, so use it when her SP is as high as possible.
messages.火傷の付与: 解析Ⅲから的中時に火傷6を付与する(解析Ⅱ以前は表面的中時に火傷4: **Inflicting Burn**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, inflicts 6 Burn on hit (4 Burn on Heads Hit at Threadspin Ⅱ or below). It becomes an extra damage source for Burn teams.
messages.威力の伸び: マッチ威力は解析Ⅲで18~24、解析Ⅳで18~28。必要資源が憤怒: **Power growth**: Clash Power is 18–24 at Threadspin Ⅲ and 18–28 at Threadspin Ⅳ. Its requirements are a light 2 Wrath and 2 Lust, making it easy to use even on battlefields with limited resources.
messages.パッシブ「芸術」: 前のターンに倒した敵1体につき、被ダメージと与ダメージが5%: **Passive — Art**: For each enemy she defeated on the previous turn, damage taken and dealt increase by 5%. It suits regular battles where enemies fall easily, but damage taken also rises, so watch out for hits.
messages.単体ボスや混乱区間に入る直前の敵に撃ち、脆弱が乗る次のターンに味方全員で攻める。: Use it on a single boss or an enemy about to hit its Stagger Threshold, then have the whole team attack on the next turn while Fragile is active.
messages.自分の火力より、味方の攻勢を強める目的で使う。: Use it to strengthen allies' offense rather than for her own damage.
messages.初期E.G.Oなので侵蝕スキルは無く。: As a starting E.G.O, it has no Corrosion skill.
messages.罪悪耐性は暴食と嫉妬が脆弱なので、弱点を突かれやすい点に注意。: Its Sin resistances are Fatal to Gluttony and Envy, so be aware that she is easy to hit for weakness damage.
messages.Ⅱ: 「芸術」が解放されるだけで、スキルは変わらない。: **Ⅱ**: Only unlocks Art; the skill does not change.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が14から18になり、的中時の火傷6と、表面的中時の脆弱1が加わる: **Ⅲ**: Base Power rises from 14 to 18, and 6 Burn on hit and 1 Fragile on Heads Hit are added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+6から+10になり、的中時にも脆弱1が付く。上げる価値が最も: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power rises from +6 to +10, and 1 Fragile is also applied on hit. This is likely the most worthwhile upgrade.
messages.南部リウ協会4課: 全スキルが火傷を付与し、「対象の火傷が6以上」で強化される効: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0407)**: All of her skills inflict Burn, and she has effects that power up when the target has at least 6 Burn, which meshes with this E.G.O's 6 Burn. She also supplies Wrath and Lust resources.
messages.りょ・ミ・パ厨房長: S1(憤怒)とS3(色欲)で必要資源の憤怒・色欲を出せ、S: **[R.B. Chef de Cuisine](persona:0404)**: S1 (Wrath) and S3 (Lust) supply the required Wrath and Lust, and S3's damage grows with the HP the target has lost.
